assumptions.statement: The repository provisional overall-design and key-area polygons are used for intake design and recalculation only.
assumptions.impact: Every precision-sensitive layer, metric, figure, PDF and HTML must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setbacks, road/rail redlines and parcel controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory development intensity, building height, road section or engineering alignment is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Submitted building polygons are conceptual spatial prototypes, not surveyed existing buildings or approved construction.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish decisions require ownership, age, structure, fire, heritage and occupancy surveys.

assumptions.statement: Operators, staffing, baseline service demand, budget, insurance and procurement routes are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: RACI, resource envelopes and service targets are design hypotheses and graduation gates, not commitments.

assumptions.statement: All 16 AI scenarios are concept proposals; no live resident, disabled-user, worker or incident test has occurred.
assumptions.impact: Scenarios remain simulation/contained/limited until separate ethics, data, safety, accessibility and professional review.

assumptions.statement: No regional partnership, curriculum recognition, data exchange, procurement or certification has been confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Regional links describe optional train-the-trainer interfaces and require separate consent and local validation.

assumptions.statement: Microclimate, flood, energy, water, heat and ecological maintenance baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Climate classrooms are a monitoring and design direction; no resilience or savings performance is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Public participation, compensation, operating hours and non-AI service capacity have not been negotiated.
assumptions.impact: Inclusion targets are proposed decision gates and must be recalibrated with affected groups and authorised operators.
